_comment: Team-shared MCP config (manual mode: no CHONKS_SERVER_PY, so the proxy never tries to spawn a local backend). Commit this as .mcp.json at your repository root next to chonks-subsystems.json. ${VAR} references expand from each user's environment: CHONKS_MCP_DIR = where they unpacked the built mcp-server/. The backend has no authentication, so it must only be reachable on a trusted network.
